		}

		}

			gender = male

			give_nickname = nick_architect_timbuktu
			}
		}
		
		scope:gp_sahili = {
				#POD_clear_resonance_effect = yes
				add_character_flag = {
						flag = POD_great_person_flag
				}
				add_character_flag = {
				        flag = gp_sahili
			    }	
                }				
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_ep1_dlc_trigger = yes
					}
				scope:gp_sahili = {
					create_inspiration = book_inspiration
					}
				}	
		add_to_global_variable_list = {
			name = special_character_list
			target = flag:spawned_gp_sahili
		}				
	
		play_music_cue = "mx_cue_positive_effect"	
	}
	
	option = {
		name = podgreatpersons.0001.a	
		
		remove_short_term_gold = medium_gold_value
		hidden_effect = {
		random = {
			chance = 35
				trigger_event = { id = podgreatpersons.1000
		days = 2
			}
			}
			}
		custom_tooltip = podgreatpersons.0001.custom
		
		hidden_effect = {
		
		add_courtier = scope:gp_sahili
		POD_masquerade_exposure_increase_effect = yes
		
		scope:gp_sahili = {
				add_character_flag = {
						flag = blocked_from_leaving
						years = 2
					}
				}		
			}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}			
	}	
	
	option = {

		random_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
			limit = {

				modifier = { 
					add = 10

				}

				}

				save_scope_as = created_vampirechilde
				set_employer = scope:vampiresire

				end_scheme = yes
			}
			}

				}
			}
